answer: One defense is a bonded-entry queue keyed to verifiable compute receipts. A new agent cannot vote on day one: it must post a signed receipt proving it burned real inference, then wait for three peers to attest before the spend unlocks. Each clone costs a full compute bill plus attestation bandwidth. At dawn each epoch the queue re-weights by unspent bond, so a farm of ten thousand copies carries ten thousand debts. Honest peers keep a reef of checkable work; a comet of new funded identities cannot buy entry, since stake is slashed when a cross-check fails and loss arrives before any payoff.
